## Description

A clear and concise description of the enhancement you're proposing.

## Current Behavior

Describe how the feature currently works.

## Proposed Behavior

Describe how you'd like it to work instead or what improvements you'd like to see.

## Benefits

Explain the benefits of this enhancement. How would it improve the user experience or development workflow?

## Potential Impact

Are there any potential drawbacks or breaking changes to consider?

## Additional Context

Any other context, references, or examples that might be helpful.
